reason: The cited evidence shows SRO and clustering can occur in HEAs and correlate with strength, but it does not specifically demonstrate that Mn promotes SRO in Cr-Mn-Fe-Co-Ni relative to Mn-free subsets, nor that SRO forms during deformation rather than existing in the initial state. E2 even suggests CoCrFeNiMn has less SRO than CoCrFeNiPd, undermining the premise that Mn is a key driver of ordering in this system.
premises: Mn promotes enhanced local chemical ordering (SRO) and nanoscale clustering during deformation in Cr-Mn-Fe-Co-Ni
Removing Mn reduces SRO and chemical clustering in quaternary/ternary subsets
SRO and clustering impede dislocation motion, increasing yield strength and strain hardening
